shrooming.boundary: Published-state inspection, sandbox reading, greenhouse question probing, and an explicit formal greenhouse round advance are executable. RUN_READING_ROUND now advances history by writing a new immutable round file derived from the previous published greenhouse history with provenance checks. R111 is the first such NOSTROMO-executed formal advance. It remains a repository-native deterministic/single-model experimental transition, not ten independently persistent live LLM processes, and it is not auto-triggered by ordinary CI.

muther.boundary: Published mining-state audit and repository corpus mining are closed-loop executable. Query-scoped Google Drive mining is executed by the authorized external connector runtime and handed back as redacted evidence. Exhaustive whole-Drive mining/falsification remains unavailable.

droplet.boundary: Published evidence audit and explicit-URL verification are closed-loop executable. Search-engine discovery is executed by the external web connector runtime and handed back as evidence; claim-specific autonomous VERIFY remains request-only.
